name: What factors influence the valuation of a luxury property in the South Florida market?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the valuation of a luxury property in the South Florida market?

acceptedAnswer.text: The valuation of a luxury property in South Florida is influenced by a combination of factors beyond standard market trends, including location, unique amenities, architectural significance, recent high-end comparable sales, and privacy features. Waterfront access, views, and specific community features in areas like Fisher Island or Key Biscayne significantly impact value. The condition of bespoke finishes, smart home technology, and expansive outdoor living spaces also play a crucial role. Kelby Contreras considers these specific elements to accurately assess and position luxury properties within the competitive South Florida market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury property valuation in South Florida is influenced by location, unique amenities, architecture, comparable high-end sales, and privacy features, especially waterfront access and community specifics.
